text:
Alex: Heads-up — nightly perf regression for 8-GPU runs when kv-prefetch + cuda-graphs are enabled. Latency jumped ~2.7x. nvprof shows idle gaps while NCCL queues appear full.

Mira: Oof. Can you paste the repro command and the trimmed trace? Which model/config?

Alex: Repro: 
```
./infra/run_serving --model=gpt-13b --tp=2 --pp=1 --gpus=8 --batch=16 --kv-prefetch=on --cuda-graphs=on --kernel-profile=all
```
Trace trimmed: repeated cudaStreamWaitEvent calls inside captured graph and NCCL launches observed on a different stream during replay.

Tony: Quick guess — during capture we recorded kernels bound to stream A, but at replay we rebind graph launch to stream B to try to overlap comms. Kernel selector may pick graph-specialized kernels assuming stream A attributes. Replay on B could force fallback or implicit syncs.

Alex: Snippet from runtime logs/nvtx:
```
[3372] cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream=0x7f, event=0xabc)  // host fences before capture end
[3372] cudaGraphLaunch(graph=0x1a) -> kernels on stream 0x7f
[3372] NCCL_AllReduce queued on stream 0x3c  // outside capture
[3372] cudaStreamSynchronize(0x3c) -> long stall
```

Mira: That rings a bell — we had an issue where prefetch moved ops to background streams and we used event-based fencing instead of record/record. Changed stream ownership ordering and the selector assumes per-stream kernel attrs.

Tony: Kernel selector logs show fallback to attention_generic_ccs during replay. That kernel is much worse on A100 for seq_len=2048.

InfraBot: CI note — nightly perf job 2026-03-17 build flagged regression, job id 87421. Marked for triage.

Alex: Minimal repro steps I used: set ENV DEBUG_KERNEL_LOG=1, enable kv-prefetch, run with --cuda-graphs. Output includes:
```
[KernelSelector] chosen kernel: attention_generic_ccs (score 0.74)  // expected attention_tile_opt
[GraphReplay] launching graph on stream 0x3c (repatched)
```

Mira: Can you capture per-kernel SM occupancy / perf counters and paste kernel selection inputs (seq_len, batch, kv_chunks)? Timing jitter during prefetch could change selector weights.

Alex: seq_len=2048, kv_chunks=4, batch=16. Perf counters: low launch occupancy for attention_generic_ccs, high memory-stalls. nvprof excerpt attached in ticket.

Tony: Quick experiment: force tile_opt kernel during replay (bypass fallback) and run. If latency returns close to baseline it's selector mismatch.

Mira: Also try forcing replay to use original capture stream (preserve-capture-stream) — see if rebind is the main issue.

Alex: Results: forcing kernel -> latency ~ baseline (~5% diff). forcing original stream -> still ~1.2x slower but NCCL stalls disappear.

Mira: That suggests two correlated failures: 1) selector chooses suboptimal kernel when graph is rebound to a different stream; 2) rebind breaks comm/compute overlap assumptions and can cause implicit sync/backpressure.

Tony: Action list:
- Mira: add guard in KernelSelector to prefer graph-optimized kernels during graph replay (P1).
- Alex: upload nvprof/cupti traces + minimal repro (P0).
- Infra: add nightly test variant combining kv-prefetch + cuda-graphs on 8 GPUs.

Alex: Uploaded repro bundle to /tmp/repro_graph_stream_handoff.tar.gz and filed traces in the ticket.

Mira: I'll prototype a selector guard and add runtime flag "preserve-capture-stream" to avoid automatic rebinds.

Tony: Short-term mitigation: disable graph auto-rebind for workloads with kv-prefetch enabled until we harden selector and stream affinity.

InfraBot: Created ticket RW-9876: "graph stream rebind -> kernel mismatch + NCCL stalls" assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: high.

Alex: Quick workaround pushed locally — prefer capture-stream affinity during replay cut regression by ~40% in smoke tests. Will open PR with toggle.

Mira: Good progress. We'll follow with a deeper postmortem once root cause is nailed. Tagging @Tony for follow-up on selector weights. :thumbsup:

Tony: On it. Starting with reproducer now.

InfraBot: Last CI ping at 2060301350 - nightly build recorded.

Alex: If someone needs the raw traces from the failing instance ping me and I'll attach them to the ticket.

Mira: Thanks everyone, will update when I have a selector patch ready.

(End of thread)
